Primary request: create an exterior aerial bird's-eye establishing view of ONE very SMALL ivory/grey passenger shuttle BUS driving along a narrow winding paved mountain road in rural China, surrounded by an immense forested mountain. The bus is distant, seen from its roof, only about 2.5–3% of the entire image width, clearly tiny compared with the landscape. Its long axis follows the road toward the TOP of frame, located close to the central road section, with a soft grounded afternoon shadow. A naturally winding S-shaped road traverses the frame vertically from bottom to top. Deep green/olive trees, a few subdued golden afternoon leaves and exposed rock on steep slopes; no visible sky/horizon. Dense forest occupies at least 85% of the composition. Road occupies a narrow strip, plenty of vertical road before and behind the bus; no other cars, no pedestrians, no temple, no buildings.
Style: match the existing game's 2D illustrated narrative scenes, realistic landscape proportions, fine dark structural contours, broad matte color shapes, softly dappled sunny afternoon light, warm muted olive/gold/charcoal palette and natural soft shadows. Quiet remote mountain feeling. No photorealism, no 3D render, no anime, no isometric toy map, no giant foreground vehicle.
The app will gently pan the whole picture DOWNWARD over two seconds to imply the bus continuing up the mountain. Compose with generous forest and road toward top and bottom for overscan cropping. Wide landscape 16:9, 1672x941 or larger 16:9. NO UI, text, road labels, captions, watermark, frame, black bars or collage.
